subject.title: feat(canvas): widget design system — theme tokens, base styles, live host theme bridge

question: Should the public widget `--accent-fg` token be defined as the host primary-button foreground so `button.primary` always follows the host contrast contract?
rationale: The PR introduces a durable agent-facing widget CSS vocabulary, and the current mapping intentionally differs from the host primary-button token in at least one supported theme; maintainers need to confirm the permanent semantic contract rather than leave two competing foreground conventions.

options.title: Align primary foreground
options.body: Map the widget primary-action foreground to the host primary-button foreground, then cover Dash dark and document that `button.primary` mirrors host primary controls.

options.title: Keep accent foreground
options.body: Retain the current mapping only if maintainers explicitly accept that widget primary actions may intentionally differ from host primary-button contrast semantics, with a documented rationale.

recommendation.title: Align primary foreground
recommendation.body: Map the widget primary-action foreground to the host primary-button foreground, then cover Dash dark and document that `button.primary` mirrors host primary controls.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the new widget token vocabulary and recorded the current contrast-policy choice in the PR discussion.
